mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ATND_POLICY_ID, POLICY_NM, DEPT_CD, WORK_BGN_TM, WORK_END_TM, BREAK_MIN, LATE_GRACE_MIN, STD_WORK_MIN_DAY, STD_WORK_DAYS_WK, STD_WORK_MIN_WK, MAX_OT_MIN_WK, OT_UNIT_MIN, ANNUAL_LEAVE_DEF, EFF_BGN_YMD, EFF_END_YMD, USE_YN, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_REG_DT, LAST_MDFR_ID, LAST_MDFCN_DT FROM TB_ATND_POLICY WHERE DEPT_CD IS NULL AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND EFF_BGN_YMD <= #{baseDate} AND (EFF_END_YMD IS NULL OR #{baseDate} <= EFF_END_YMD) ORDER BY EFF_BGN_YMD DESC, ATND_POLICY_ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_ATND_POLICY SET EFF_END_YMD = #{endYmd}, USE_YN = 'N', LAST_MDFR_ID = #{mdfrId}, LAST_MDFCN_DT = #{now} WHERE DEPT_CD IS NULL AND USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_ATND_POLICY_ID.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_ATND_POLICY ( ATND_POLICY_ID, POLICY_NM, DEPT_CD, WORK_BGN_TM, WORK_END_TM, BREAK_MIN, LATE_GRACE_MIN, STD_WORK_MIN_DAY, STD_WORK_DAYS_WK, STD_WORK_MIN_WK, MAX_OT_MIN_WK, OT_UNIT_MIN, ANNUAL_LEAVE_DEF, EFF_BGN_YMD, EFF_END_YMD, USE_YN, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_REG_DT ) VALUES ( #{atndPolicyId}, #{policyNm}, #{deptCd}, #{workBgnTm}, #{workEndTm}, #{breakMin}, #{lateGraceMin}, #{stdWorkMinDay}, #{stdWorkDaysWk}, #{stdWorkMinWk}, #{maxOtMinWk}, #{otUnitMin}, #{annualLeaveDef}, #{effBgnYmd}, NULL, 'Y', #{frstRgtrId}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT EMP_ID, ATND_DT, TRIM(ATND_STAT_CD) AS ATND_STAT_CD, APPLY_POLICY_ID, WRK_START_DTM, WRK_END_DTM, CHKIN_IP, CHKOUT_IP, LATE_MIN, EARLY_LEAVE_MIN, WORK_MIN, NORMAL_WORK_MIN, OT_MIN, APPROVED_OT_MIN, EXCESS_MIN, LEAVE_DAY, SRC_LEAVE_REQ_ID, FRST_REG_DT, LAST_MDFCN_DT FROM TB_ATND_DAILY WHERE EMP_ID = #{empId} AND ATND_DT = TRUNC(#{atndDt})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_ATND_DAILY ( EMP_ID, ATND_DT, ATND_STAT_CD, APPLY_POLICY_ID, WRK_START_DTM, CHKIN_IP, LATE_MIN, FRST_REG_DT ) VALUES ( #{empId}, TRUNC(#{atndDt}), #{atndStatCd}, #{applyPolicyId}, #{wrkStartDtm}, #{chkinIp}, #{lateMin}, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_ATND_DAILY SET ATND_STAT_CD = #{atndStatCd}, WRK_END_DTM = #{wrkEndDtm}, CHKOUT_IP = #{chkoutIp}, EARLY_LEAVE_MIN = #{earlyLeaveMin}, WORK_MIN = #{workMin}, NORMAL_WORK_MIN = #{normalWorkMin}, OT_MIN = #{otMin}, APPROVED_OT_MIN = #{approvedOtMin}, EXCESS_MIN = #{excessMin}, LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE WHERE EMP_ID = #{empId} AND ATND_DT = TRUNC(#{atndDt})
mapper.select: SELECT D.ATND_DT, D.WRK_START_DTM, D.WRK_END_DTM, D.WORK_MIN, D.LATE_MIN, D.OT_MIN, TRIM(D.ATND_STAT_CD) AS ATND_STAT_CD, SE.ATND_SE_CD_NM AS ATND_STAT_NM FROM TB_ATND_DAILY D LEFT JOIN TB_ATND_SE_CD SE ON SE.ATND_SE_CD = D.ATND_STAT_CD WHERE D.EMP_ID = #{empId} AND D.ATND_DT BETWEEN TRUNC(#{from}) AND TRUNC(#{to}) ORDER BY D.ATND_DT DESC

SELECT NVL(SUM(WORK_MIN), 0) AS WORK_MIN, NVL(SUM(NORMAL_WORK_MIN), 0) AS NORMAL_WORK_MIN, NVL(SUM(OT_MIN), 0) AS OT_MIN, NVL(SUM(APPROVED_OT_MIN), 0) AS APPROVED_OT_MIN, NVL(SUM(EXCESS_MIN), 0) AS EXCESS_MIN, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN LATE_MIN > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS LATE_CNT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN EARLY_LEAVE_MIN > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS EARLY_LEAVE_CNT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN TRIM(ATND_STAT_CD) = 'HALF' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS HALF_DAY_CNT, NVL(SUM(LEAVE_DAY), 0) AS LEAVE_USE_DAY FROM TB_ATND_DAILY WHERE EMP_ID = #{empId} AND ATND_DT BETWEEN TRUNC(#{from}) AND TRUNC(#{to})
SELECT NVL(SUM(LEAVE_DAY_CNT), 0) FROM TB_ATND_LEAVE_REQ WHERE EMP_ID = #{empId} AND RFLCT_YN = 'Y' AND TRUNC(LEAVE_BGN_DTM) BETWEEN TRUNC(#{from}) AND TRUNC(#{to})

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ATND_LEAVE_REQ R JOIN TB_ATND_LEAVE_TYPE T ON T.LEAVE_TYPE_CD = R.LEAVE_TYPE_CD WHERE R.EMP_ID = #{empId} AND R.RFLCT_YN = 'Y' AND T.HALF_DAY_CD IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(R.LEAVE_BGN_DTM) BETWEEN TRUNC(#{from}) AND TRUNC(#{to})

SELECT D.EMP_ID, E.EMP_NM, DEPT.DEPT_NM, GRD.JOB_GRD_NM AS JBPS_NM, E.PRFL_IMG_FILE_ID, D.ATND_DT, D.WRK_START_DTM, D.WRK_END_DTM, D.LATE_MIN, D.WORK_MIN, D.OT_MIN, TRIM(D.ATND_STAT_CD) AS ATND_STAT_CD, SE.ATND_SE_CD_NM AS ATND_STAT_NM FROM TB_ATND_DAILY D JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE E ON E.EMP_ID = D.EMP_ID LEFT JOIN TB_DEPARTMENT DEPT ON DEPT.DEPT_CD = E.DEPT_CD LEFT JOIN TB_JOB_GRADE GRD ON GRD.JOB_GRD_CD = E.JOB_GRD_CD LEFT JOIN TB_ATND_SE_CD SE ON SE.ATND_SE_CD = D.ATND_STAT_CD WHERE D.ATND_DT = TRUNC(#{atndDt})
AND E.DEPT_CD = #{deptCd}
AND E.EMP_NM LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
ORDER BY DEPT.DEPT_NM, E.EMP_NM

SELECT E.EMP_ID, E.EMP_NM, DEPT.DEPT_NM, GRD.JOB_GRD_NM AS JBPS_NM, E.PRFL_IMG_FILE_ID, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN D.WRK_START_DTM IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS PRESENT_DAYS, NVL(SUM(D.WORK_MIN), 0) AS WORK_MIN, NVL(SUM(D.OT_MIN), 0) AS OT_MIN, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN D.LATE_MIN > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS LATE_CNT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN D.EARLY_LEAVE_MIN > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS EARLY_LEAVE_CNT, NVL(SUM(D.LEAVE_DAY), 0) AS LEAVE_DAYS FROM TB_EMPLOYEE E LEFT JOIN TB_DEPARTMENT DEPT ON DEPT.DEPT_CD = E.DEPT_CD LEFT JOIN TB_JOB_GRADE GRD ON GRD.JOB_GRD_CD = E.JOB_GRD_CD LEFT JOIN TB_ATND_DAILY D ON D.EMP_ID = E.EMP_ID AND D.ATND_DT BETWEEN TRUNC(#{from}) AND TRUNC(#{to})
AND E.DEPT_CD = #{deptCd}
AND E.EMP_NM LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
GROUP BY E.EMP_ID, E.EMP_NM, DEPT.DEPT_NM, GRD.JOB_GRD_NM, E.PRFL_IMG_FILE_ID ORDER BY DEPT.DEPT_NM, E.EMP_NM

SELECT D.EMP_ID, E.EMP_NM, DEPT.DEPT_NM, GRD.JOB_GRD_NM AS JBPS_NM, E.PRFL_IMG_FILE_ID, D.ATND_DT, D.WRK_START_DTM, D.WRK_END_DTM, D.LATE_MIN, D.WORK_MIN, D.OT_MIN, TRIM(D.ATND_STAT_CD) AS ATND_STAT_CD, SE.ATND_SE_CD_NM AS ATND_STAT_NM FROM TB_ATND_DAILY D JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE E ON E.EMP_ID = D.EMP_ID LEFT JOIN TB_DEPARTMENT DEPT ON DEPT.DEPT_CD = E.DEPT_CD LEFT JOIN TB_JOB_GRADE GRD ON GRD.JOB_GRD_CD = E.JOB_GRD_CD LEFT JOIN TB_ATND_SE_CD SE ON SE.ATND_SE_CD = D.ATND_STAT_CD WHERE D.EMP_ID = #{empId} AND D.ATND_DT BETWEEN TRUNC(#{from}) AND TRUNC(#{to}) ORDER BY D.ATND_DT DESC
SELECT LEAVE_TYPE_CD, LEAVE_TYPE_NM, DEDUCT_DAY, PAID_YN, HALF_DAY_CD FROM TB_ATND_LEAVE_TYPE WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY SORT_ORDER, LEAVE_TYPE_CD
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_ATND_LEAVE_REQ_ID.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_ATND_LEAVE_REQ ( LEAVE_REQ_ID, EMP_ID, LEAVE_TYPE_CD, DRFT_DOC_SN, LEAVE_BGN_DTM, LEAVE_END_DTM, LEAVE_DAY_CNT, REQ_RSN, APRVL_STTUS_CD, RFLCT_YN, FRST_REG_DT ) VALUES ( #{leaveReqId}, #{empId}, #{leaveTypeCd}, #{drftDocSn}, #{leaveBgnDtm}, #{leaveEndDtm}, #{leaveDayCnt}, #{reqRsn}, '01', 'N', SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT LEAVE_REQ_ID, EMP_ID, LEAVE_TYPE_CD, DRFT_DOC_SN, LEAVE_BGN_DTM, LEAVE_END_DTM, LEAVE_DAY_CNT, REQ_RSN, APRVL_STTUS_CD, RFLCT_YN, RFLCT_DT, FRST_REG_DT FROM TB_ATND_LEAVE_REQ WHERE DRFT_DOC_SN = #{drftDocSn}
mapper.update: MERGE INTO TB_ATND_DAILY t USING (SELECT #{empId} AS EMP_ID, TRUNC(#{atndDt}) AS ATND_DT FROM DUAL) s ON (t.EMP_ID = s.EMP_ID AND t.ATND_DT = s.ATND_DT) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.ATND_STAT_CD = #{statCd}, t.LEAVE_DAY = #{leaveDay}, t.SRC_LEAVE_REQ_ID = #{leaveReqId}, t.LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (EMP_ID, ATND_DT, ATND_STAT_CD, LEAVE_DAY, SRC_LEAVE_REQ_ID, FRST_REG_DT) VALUES (s.EMP_ID, s.ATND_DT, #{statCd}, #{leaveDay}, #{leaveReqId}, SYSDATE)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_ATND_LEAVE_LEDGER ( LEAVE_LEDGER_ID, EMP_ID, BASE_YEAR, LEDGER_SE_CD, LEAVE_DAY, SRC_LEAVE_REQ_ID, RMRK, FRST_REG_DT ) VALUES ( SEQ_ATND_LEAVE_LEDGER_ID.NEXTVAL, #{empId}, #{baseYear}, #{ledgerSeCd}, #{leaveDay}, #{srcLeaveReqId}, #{rmrk}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT R.LEAVE_REQ_ID, R.DRFT_DOC_SN, T.LEAVE_TYPE_NM, R.LEAVE_BGN_DTM, R.LEAVE_END_DTM, R.LEAVE_DAY_CNT, R.REQ_RSN, R.APRVL_STTUS_CD, R.RFLCT_YN, R.FRST_REG_DT FROM TB_ATND_LEAVE_REQ R LEFT JOIN TB_ATND_LEAVE_TYPE T ON T.LEAVE_TYPE_CD = R.LEAVE_TYPE_CD WHERE R.EMP_ID = #{empId} ORDER BY R.FRST_REG_DT DESC
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_ATND_OT_REQ_ID.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_ATND_OT_REQ ( OT_REQ_ID, EMP_ID, OT_DT, OT_BGN_DTM, OT_END_DTM, DRFT_DOC_SN, APRVL_STTUS_CD, RFLCT_YN ) VALUES ( #{otReqId}, #{empId}, TRUNC(#{otDt}), #{otBgnDtm}, #{otEndDtm}, #{drftDocSn}, '01', 'N' )
mapper.select: SELECT OT_REQ_ID, EMP_ID, OT_DT, OT_BGN_DTM, OT_END_DTM, APPROVED_MIN, DRFT_DOC_SN, APRVL_STTUS_CD, RFLCT_YN FROM TB_ATND_OT_REQ WHERE DRFT_DOC_SN = #{drftDocSn}
SELECT NVL(SUM(APPROVED_MIN), 0) FROM TB_ATND_OT_REQ WHERE EMP_ID = #{empId} AND OT_DT = TRUNC(#{otDt}) AND RFLCT_YN = 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_ATND_DAILY SET APPROVED_OT_MIN = LEAST(OT_MIN, #{approvedMin}), EXCESS_MIN = OT_MIN - LEAST(OT_MIN, #{approvedMin}), LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE WHERE EMP_ID = #{empId} AND ATND_DT = TRUNC(#{atndDt})
mapper.select: SELECT OT_REQ_ID, DRFT_DOC_SN, OT_DT, OT_BGN_DTM, OT_END_DTM, APPROVED_MIN, APRVL_STTUS_CD, RFLCT_YN FROM TB_ATND_OT_REQ WHERE EMP_ID = #{empId} ORDER BY OT_DT DESC, OT_REQ_ID DESC
